_comment: Hard ordering constraints of the route. 'global_precedence': every step of a 'before' process precedes every step of an 'after' process (whatever the feature); tokens are a process name, '@group' (process_groups), '@cutting' (every tooling process outside the final group, grinding included), '@machining' (@cutting without grinding: on-machine) or '*'. 'precedence': [before, after] for steps of the SAME feature. 'requires': a process needs the other one on the same feature. The order among unconstrained steps comes from the process phases (process_templates.json).
_standards: Route principles of GOST 3.1109 / ESTD and standard CAPP practice: (1) the datum surfaces are machined first; (2) surfaces with the largest stock next: roughing of all features before finishing (stages separated, so that residual stress, heat and clamping deformation are released before the final cuts); (3) heat treatment between roughing and finishing: fixing holes and tapped threads before hardening, finishing, reaming, boring and grinding after it; (4) holes after the faces and floors they start from; (5) the most accurate surfaces last; (6) auxiliary operations (entry chamfers, countersinks) before threads and precision bores of the same hole; (7) deburring after all material removal (ISO 13715); cleaning, inspection and coating off the machine, coating after inspection.

global_precedence.reason: all roughing before any finishing (stages separated)
holes after milling of the faces and floors they start from
roughing, fixing holes and tapped threads before hardening
finishing, reaming, boring and grinding after heat treatment (distortion, hardness)
deburring after heat treatment (scale, raised edges)
final inspection after all material removal

invalid_combinations.message: Machining after coating/plating damages the coating
Heat treatment after coating/plating destroys the coating
Final inspection must follow all machining

nesting._comment: A pocket/slot (container) that a deeper pocket, slot or hole opens from is roughed before the inner feature is roughed or drilled; the inner feature then starts at the container floor.
